scanNote: 1-mashqdagi rasm qora-oq eskiz. Kiyim so'zlari ro'yxatida 13 ta so'z va rasmda 8 ta odam bor — quyida har bir so'z BIR MARTA ishlatilgan taqsimot berilgan. Eskiz qo'pol chizilgani uchun ba'zi buyumlarni boshqacha taqsimlash ham mumkin; asosiysi — har bir odam uchun 'is wearing' va 'is doing' gaplarini to'g'ri tuzish. Mashg'ulotlar taqsimoti esa aniq: har bir odamga bittadan.

sections.title: Vocabulary — clothes and activities in the park

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the picture and use the words in the two lists below to say what the people are wearing and what they are doing, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmga qarang va quyidagi ikki ro'yxatdagi so'zlardan foydalanib, odamlar nima kiyganini va nima qilayotganini ayting, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
1-RO'YXAT — KIYIM (13 ta):
  T-shirt ..... futbolka        shorts ..... kalta shim
  shirt ....... ko'ylak (erkak)  blouse ..... bluzka (ayol)
  skirt ....... yubka           jeans ...... jinsi shim
  dress ....... ko'ylak (ayol)  trousers ... shim
  jean shirt .. jinsi ko'ylak   cap ........ kepka
  trainers .... krossovka       hat ........ shlyapa
  a jacket .... kurtka, pidjak

2-RO'YXAT — MASHG'ULOT (8 ta):
  climb/a tree ...... daraxtga chiqmoq
  eat/a sandwich .... sendvich yemoq
  ride/a bicycle .... velosiped haydamoq
  pick/flowers ...... gul termoq
  drink/a Coke ...... kola ichmoq
  take/photographs .. suratga olmoq
  read/a book ....... kitob o'qimoq
  listen to music ... musiqa tinglamoq

RASMDAGI 8 ODAM:
  Barry   — daraxtga tirmashib chiqayapti (o'ngda)
  Linda   — engashib gul terayapti
  Tony    — velosipedda ketayapti
  Amanda  — fotoapparat bilan suratga olayapti
  Anne    — sendvich yeyayapti
  Ryan    — banka bilan kola ichayapti
  Stanley — shlyapali, ko'zoynakli chol, kitob o'qiyapti
  Mavis   — Stenlining yonida o'tirib, quloqchinda musiqa tinglayapti

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  Barry is wearing a T-shirt and shorts. He is climbing a tree.

QOLIP (ikki gap):
  1) Ism + is wearing + kiyim.
  2) He/She + is + fe'l-ING + to'ldiruvchi.

items.textEn: 1  What is Barry wearing? What is he doing?
items.answer: Barry is wearing a T-shirt and shorts. He is climbing a tree.
items.whyUz:
Kitobda BERILGAN namuna. Berri daraxtga tirmashib chiqayapti.
'climb' → 'climbing' (oddiy -ing; 'b' O'QILMAYDI: /klaɪm/).

items.textEn: 2  What is Linda wearing? What is she doing?
items.answer: Linda is wearing a dress and trainers. She is picking flowers.
items.hintUz: U engashib, qo'lida gul dastasi bor
items.whyUz:
Linda engashib gul terayapti — qo'lida gul dastasi ko'rinadi.
'pick' → 'picking'. 'trainers' = krossovka (doim ko'plikda).

items.textEn: 3  What is Anne wearing? What is she doing?
items.answer: Anne is wearing a jean shirt and trousers. She is eating a sandwich.
items.hintUz: Uzun jinsi ko'ylakda, qo'lini og'ziga olib borgan
items.whyUz:
Anne uzun jinsi ko'ylak (cho'ntakli) va och rangli shim kiygan.
Ikki qo'li bilan sendvich ushlab yeyayapti.
'eat' → 'eating' (oddiy -ing).

items.textEn: 4  What is Ryan wearing? What is he doing?
items.answer: Ryan is wearing a shirt and jeans. He is drinking a Coke.
items.hintUz: Qo'lida banka bor, uni og'ziga olib borayapti
items.whyUz:
Rayan yoqali ko'ylak va kamarli shim kiygan.
Qo'lida kola bankasi — ichayapti.
'drink' → 'drinking'. 'a Coke' — bosh harf bilan (marka nomi).

items.textEn: 5  What is Amanda wearing? What is she doing?
items.answer: Amanda is wearing a blouse and a skirt. She is taking photographs.
items.whyUz:
Amanda yoqali oq bluzka va kamarli yubka kiygan.
Fotoapparat bilan suratga olayapti.
'take photographs' = suratga olmoq → 'taking photographs' (-e TUSHDI).

items.textEn: 6  What is Tony wearing? What is he doing?
items.answer: Tony is wearing a cap. He is riding a bicycle.
items.whyUz:
Toni kepka kiygan va velosiped haydayapti.
'ride' → 'riding' (-e TUSHDI).
'a cap' — kozirekli bosh kiyim; 'a hat' — chetli shlyapa.

items.textEn: 7  What is Stanley wearing? What is he doing?
items.answer: Stanley is wearing a hat. He is reading a book.
items.hintUz: Chetli shlyapa va ko'zoynakli keksa erkak
items.whyUz:
Stenli chetli shlyapa kiygan, ko'zoynak taqqan va kitob o'qiyapti.
'read' → 'reading' (oddiy -ing).

items.textEn: 8  What is Mavis wearing? What is she doing?
items.answer: Mavis is wearing a jacket. She is listening to music.
items.whyUz:
Mavis to'q rangli kurtka kiygan va quloqchinda musiqa tinglayapti.
'listen TO music' — 'to' predlogi SHART.
'listen' → 'listening' (undosh IKKILANMAYDI — urg'u birinchi bo'g'inda).

groups.explanationUz: Ba'zi kiyimlar faqat bir jins uchun ishlatiladi.
Ikki so'z birikib yangi kiyim nomini yasaydi.
Uch imlo qoidasining qaysi biri ishlaganini ko'ring.

patterns.formula: What is + ism + WEARING? — Ism + is wearing + kiyim.
patterns.exampleEn: What is Barry wearing? — Barry is wearing a T-shirt and shorts.
patterns.exampleUz: Berri nima kiygan? — Berri futbolka va kalta shim kiygan.
patterns.explanationUz:
'wear' = kiyib turmoq (holat).
Present Continuous — HOZIRGI holatni bildiradi.

patterns.formula: What is he/she DOING? — He/She is + fe'l-ING.
patterns.exampleEn: What is he doing? — He is climbing a tree.
patterns.exampleUz: U nima qilayapti? — U daraxtga chiqayapti.
patterns.explanationUz: 'do' fe'li savolda, javobda esa aniq fe'l ishlatiladi.

patterns.exampleEn: a T-shirt and shorts, a blouse and a skirt, a jean shirt and trousers
patterns.exampleUz: futbolka va kalta shim, bluzka va yubka, jinsi ko'ylak va shim
patterns.explanationUz:
BIRLIK kiyimda 'a' shart: A blouse and A skirt.
KO'PLIK kiyimda 'a' YO'Q: shorts, trousers, jeans, trainers.
